statement: A position match override (force_pair) reaches the pair table but the edge is dropped when position ids are assigned: the coexistence (twin) veto compares par converted to USD within 2 pct, so an FX move on a non-USD loan makes a same-currency continuation look further apart than a USD line of the same borrower. Three Goldman loans are split across two position ids (Spectrum EUR, Northstar NOK, Solar AUD); a fourth failed override (Northstar USD 10,582) has no verified cause. Values, par and currency are right; only position_id is wrong. Next action: exempt override edges from the veto, or compare par in its own currency, with a test and a cohort measurement of position_id changes.
